description: This file defines the ProductDao interface which extends a generic DAO for Product entities, providing methods for retrieving products based on various criteria such as locale, categories, store, tax class, SEO URL, and product code within the sales management application.

methods.name: getProductForLocale
methods.description: Retrieves a product by ID tailored for a specific locale and language.

methods.name: getProductsForLocale
methods.description: Fetches a list of products available for a specific locale, store, and set of categories.

methods.name: getProductsListByCategories
methods.description: Obtains a list of products filtered by categories.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Returns a list of products available in a store, optionally filtered by language and criteria.

methods.name: listByTaxClass
methods.description: Gets products associated with a specific tax class.

methods.name: getProductsListByCategories
methods.description: Fetches products filtered by category IDs with language support.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a product based on its SEO URL within a store and locale.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a product by its code and language.
